_hinweis: Texts on the topic of playing time. talent_wartet_auf_einsatz: the assistant manager writes (informal). The other two: the player writes to the manager (“Gaffer”, formal); the manager replies informally. Placeholders: {spieler}, {spieler_kurz}.

standard: {spieler_kurz} is waiting for his first game
{spieler} hasn't started a single game this season. In training he's one of the standouts. At some point we have to see what he can do in a match.
I want to put {spieler_kurz} on your radar. He hasn't started a game yet but works properly every day. If he waits too long, he'll lose faith in it.
He'll get his chance from the start soon. Tell him that.
He should keep going. When he's ready, he plays. I'm not naming a date.
He's not ready yet. For the starting XI he's out of the picture until further notice.
He'll be pleased. I'll prepare him. He'll remind you of your word.
I'll tell him that. He can work with it, even if he had hoped for more.
That's hard on a lad that age. I'll break it to him, but expect him to be down.
{spieler_kurz} wants to talk about his role
Gaffer, I'm hardly in the starting XI any more. I'd like to know why that is and what you expect from me.
Gaffer, have you got a moment? I've been on the bench almost every time lately. That's not how I imagined the season. I'd like to hear how you're planning with me.

egoist: Gaffer, I belong in the starting XI, and you know it. I don't see anyone in the squad who does it better in my position. How long is this going to go on?
kumpel: Gaffer, I'm happy for the lads to play, I really am. But I'm starting to have my doubts. Just tell me honestly where I stand.
heisssporn: Gaffer, I've had enough. Week after week on the bench, and nobody tells me why. Tell me to my face.
vorbildprofi: Gaffer, I'm working as hard as before, that won't change. Still, I'd like to know what I'm missing, in your eyes, for the starting XI.
diva: Gaffer, I'm on the bench and people are asking why. So am I. A player with my ability belongs on the pitch, not next to it.
anfuehrer: Gaffer, I can't lead the team very well from the bench. Tell me what you want to see from me and you'll get it.

standard: You'll get your starts over the coming weeks.
Right now others are ahead of you. Show me in training and that will change.
I pick the team. I'm not discussing it.
Thanks, gaffer. I'm counting on that.
I don't like hearing that, but I can work with it.
Understood. Then at least I know where I stand.
{spieler_kurz} asks about his prospects
Gaffer, I know I'm not first choice. But I've never played as little as this season. Is there still a future for me here?
Gaffer, I'm at an age where I need to play. I'm not progressing on the bench. How do you see my role for the rest of the season?

egoist: Gaffer, I didn't come here to watch. If I have no part to play here, say so. Then I'll find a club where I'm on the pitch.
kumpel: Gaffer, I feel at home in the group and don't really want to leave. But just training isn't enough for me in the long run. Do you see a chance for me?
heisssporn: Gaffer, I pull myself together in training every day, and at the weekend I'm out again. What for? I want to know now.
vorbildprofi: Gaffer, I accept my role and I'm there when you need me. I just want to know whether I can expect games or should look elsewhere.
diva: Gaffer, with respect: I'm too good for the bench. Either I get a proper role here, or we find another solution.
anfuehrer: Gaffer, I keep the second row in good spirits, even without games of my own. But I want to play myself. How are you planning with me?

standard: You'll get your games, in the cup and when we rotate. Stay ready.
You're a squad player for me. That won't change much this season.
If you want to play more, I won't stand in your way if you move.
Good, that's enough for now. I'll be ready when the time comes.
At least that's a clear message. It's not nice.
Then I'll put out feelers. Thanks for being open.
